title: Is AI Really Driving Copper's Price Surge? | Presented by CME Group
description:
Grid expansion and electrification are reshaping copper demand, with AI infrastructure adding momentum. But with industry and construction still accounting for about half the market, can multiyear infrastructure spending loosen copper's ties to the traditional economic cycle? Presented by @cmegroup
